## bs.ts

Source: [src/utils/bs.ts](../../../src/utils/bs.ts)

Bikram Sambat (BS), the Nepali calendar. Dates are still stored as AD
`yyyy-mm-dd`; this module only converts them for display and for the
month grids, so persisted data and the SQL stay unchanged.

Month lengths for BS 2000–2090 (AD 1943–2034) from the official calendar,
one digit per month as `days − 29` (MIT data from nepali-date-converter).

*function* · [src/utils/bs.ts:114](../../../src/utils/bs.ts#L114)

## confirm.ts

Source: [src/utils/confirm.ts](../../../src/utils/confirm.ts)

### `confirm`

*function* · [src/utils/confirm.ts:8](../../../src/utils/confirm.ts#L8)

```ts
confirm(title: string, message: string, confirmLabel: string, onConfirm: () => void)
```

Confirmation before a destructive or important action. Shows the app's own
dialog (the same on iOS, Android and web, translated with the rest of the
app); destructive labels such as "Delete" get a red button.
